lessons.title: Briefing & estrutura: linguagem de negociação para a Apresentação 2
lessons.objective: Ao final desta aula você domina a linguagem de negociação com condicionais simples — "If you confirm, we will..." — e expressões para pedir, ceder e propor um meio-termo.
lessons.overview:
The second presentation of the module is a cost, deadline and contract negotiation with Amazon/AWS. Today, on the Monday briefing, you prepare the blueprint for this conversation: the language that opens room for an agreement without losing Racional's position. Negotiating in A2 English is possible when you master a few structures and repeat them calmly.

The heart of the lesson is the first conditional: If you confirm, we will lock the price. The rule is simple and looks like engineering, a condition (if + present) and a result (will + verb). For softer offers, there is the next step: If we extended the deadline, it would reduce the cost. You link a proposal to something in return, always. Nothing is given for free.

Along with this come the expressions of polite request and concession: Could we...?, Would that work?, to meet halfway and to find common ground. For AWS, which negotiates on volume and tight deadlines, this language shows that Racional is firm on value but flexible on the path, exactly the balance that opens a data center contract.
lessons.intro:
Hoje a planta é a condicional de negociação. Memorize o molde: "If you + presente, we will + verbo."

E três pedidos-âncora: "Could we extend the deadline?" · "Would that work for you?" · "Let's meet halfway." Toda proposta liga uma condição a um resultado.
lessons.situation: Na segunda anterior à negociação, você ensaia as frases que vai usar com a Amazon/AWS para fechar preço, prazo e cláusulas sem ceder valor à toa.
lessons.context: Let me be clear about our position. If you confirm the order this month, we will lock the price for the whole project. If we extended the deadline by two weeks, it would help us reduce the cost. Could we meet halfway on the payment terms? We are flexible on the schedule, but the safety standard is not negotiable. I'm sure we can find common ground.

vocab.example: If you confirm today, we will start next week.
If we extended the deadline, it would reduce the cost.
Could we review the payment terms?
We can deliver in March. Would that work?
We can lock the price for one year.
A lower price is a trade-off for more time.
We can come down a little on the price.
Let's agree on the payment terms.
Let's meet halfway on the deadline.
We are flexible on the schedule.
I'm afraid we can't go lower.
It costs more. On the other hand, it is faster.
I'm sure we can find common ground.
Safety is a deal-breaker for us.

exercises.title: 1. Qual condicional liga oferta e contrapartida?
exercises.prompt: Você quer dizer: confirme agora e nós fixamos o preço. Qual frase está correta?

options.text: If you confirm this month, we will lock the price.
If you will confirm this month, we lock the price.
options.whyWrong: Na primeira condicional o 'if' vai com presente simples (confirm), não com 'will'.

options.text: You confirm and we are locking price maybe.
options.whyWrong: Sem estrutura condicional clara; soa vago e fraco numa negociação.

exercises.explanation: Primeira condicional: 'If + presente, we will + verbo'. É o molde que liga uma condição a um resultado.

exercises.title: 2. Complete a oferta suave
exercises.prompt: "If we ___ the deadline, it would help us reduce the cost." (use o passado de 'extend')
exercises.explanation: Para uma oferta mais suave usamos 'If + passado, it would...'. 'If we extended the deadline, it would...'.

commonErrors.extend: Aqui a oferta suave pede o passado: 'If we extended...'.
commonErrors.will extend: Com 'would' no resultado, a condição vai no passado: 'If we extended...'.

exercises.title: 3. Monte o pedido educado
exercises.explanation: 'Could we meet halfway on the price?' é um pedido educado para encontrar um meio-termo.

exercises.title: 4. Combine a expressão com a função
exercises.explanation: Cada função de negociação tem uma expressão-âncora. Saber a função certa evita ceder no que não pode.

exercises.title: 5. Escreva sua proposta condicional (2 frases)
exercises.prompt: Escreva 2 frases de negociação com a AWS: uma oferta condicional (se eles confirmarem, você faz algo) e um pedido de meio-termo. Use ao menos 2 termos em inglês desta lição. A correção é só sobre o uso dos termos.
keywords: if you confirm|lock the price|payment terms
exercises.modelAnswer: If you confirm the order this month, we will lock the price for you. Could we meet halfway on the payment terms?
exercises.explanation: Uma proposta forte sempre liga condição e resultado, e depois abre espaço para o meio-termo.

lessons.critical: Em voz alta, faça uma oferta condicional para a AWS: 'If you..., we will...', e termine pedindo um meio-termo. Sem texto na frente.
takeaways: I can make an offer with 'If you confirm, we will lock the price'.
I can soften an offer with 'If we extended..., it would...'.
I can ask politely with 'Could we...?' and 'Would that work?'.
I can suggest a middle point with 'Let's meet halfway'.
I can protect what is a deal-breaker for us.

Varie a dinâmica a cada aula — o roteiro acima rotaciona para não repetir.
Não deixar a teoria virar palestra: o aluno tem que produzir.

lessons.title: Apresentação 2 — Negociação de custo, prazo e contrato com a Amazon/AWS
lessons.objective: Ao final desta aula você conduz uma negociação completa de custo, prazo e contrato com a Amazon/AWS, fazendo ofertas condicionais, defendendo o que é inegociável e fechando um acordo.
lessons.overview:
Today is the job site of the negotiation: with the teacher in the role of Amazon/AWS, you lead a real conversation about cost, deadline and contract. It is the second capstone of the module. There is no new theory, you apply the conditional language and the polite requests you prepared on Monday.

The goal is to reach a win-win: an agreement that is good for both sides. You start by saying where Racional stands today (Let me share where we stand), present the current offer and listen to the client's request. When something changes the scope of the work, you signal that it adds to the cost, calmly, without arguing.

For AWS, deadline and safety are usually firm points. You use non-negotiable for what you do not give up and to commit to for what you take on. You close by confirming the alignment (Are we aligned?) and sealing the agreement (to close the deal). Firm on value, flexible on the path: that is how Racional wins a data center contract.
lessons.intro:
Sem teoria nova. Retome a condicional e arme três frases-âncora para a mesa com a AWS.

"Let me share where we stand." · "A scope change would add to the cost." · "Are we aligned? Let's close the deal."
lessons.situation: Reunião de negociação com a Amazon/AWS sobre o contrato de um data center: o cliente pede preço menor e prazo mais curto, e você defende custo, escopo e segurança.
lessons.context: Thank you. Let me share where we stand. Our current offer covers the full project, from start to finish. I understand you'd like a shorter deadline. lessons.title: Briefing & estrutura: linguagem de SST/report para a Apresentação 3
lessons.objective: Ao final desta aula você relata indicadores de segurança (SST) usando present perfect e voz passiva simples — "We have recorded zero incidents", "All workers are trained" — para um report executivo.
lessons.overview:
The third presentation of the module is a safety and relationship QBR (quarterly business review) with Google. Today, on the Monday briefing, you prepare the language of SST/safety (workplace safety) and of report (reporting results). For an operations director, this is the most natural ground: numbers, rules and continuous improvement.

The blueprint of the lesson has two simple and powerful grammar points. The present perfect shows a result accumulated up to today: We have recorded zero lost-time incidents this quarter. The passive voice with 'are + participle' describes a standard process without needing a subject: All workers are trained. The site is reviewed every week. These are the two structures that make a report clear and professional.

Along with this comes the compliance vocabulary: compliance, to comply with, safety standard, audit and rate. For Google, which demands global standards on every project, showing a safety track record that improves quarter after quarter is what sustains a long-term partnership. Here, speaking well about safety means speaking well about business.
lessons.intro:
Hoje a planta tem duas regras. Resultado até hoje: "We have recorded zero incidents." (present perfect). Processo padrão: "All workers are trained." (voz passiva).

E uma frase de tendência: "Our incident rate has decreased this year." Números que melhoram contam a história sozinhos.
lessons.situation: Na segunda anterior ao QBR, você ensaia o relato de segurança da obra do Google: indicadores, treinamento, auditorias e a tendência de melhoria.
lessons.context: Let me report on safety. We have recorded zero lost-time incidents this quarter. All workers are trained before they start, and the site is reviewed every week. We comply with every safety standard, and our incident rate has decreased this year. An external audit checks our work, so the numbers are reliable. We will keep this strong track record across every site.

vocab.example: We have recorded zero incidents.
We had no lost-time incident this quarter.
All workers are trained before they start.
The site is reviewed every week.
Safety compliance is very high.
We comply with every safety standard.
We follow the highest safety standard.
Our incident rate has decreased.
Our results improve every quarter.
Our incident rate is very low.
An external audit checks our work.
We enforce the safety rules every day.
Safety is strong across the board.
We have a strong safety track record.

exercises.title: 1. Qual frase relata um resultado até hoje?
exercises.prompt: Você quer dizer que, neste trimestre, não houve acidente com afastamento. Qual frase está correta?

options.text: We have recorded zero lost-time incidents this quarter.
We are record zero incident this quarter.
options.whyWrong: 'are record' não existe. O resultado acumulado usa present perfect: 'We have recorded'.

options.text: We recorded zero incident yesterday only.
options.whyWrong: Para um período que chega até agora (this quarter), o present perfect é mais natural que o passado simples.

exercises.explanation: 'We have recorded...' (present perfect) mostra um resultado acumulado até o momento do report.

exercises.title: 2. Complete o processo padrão (voz passiva)
exercises.prompt: "All workers ___ trained before they start on site."
exercises.explanation: Voz passiva de processo padrão: 'are + particípio'. 'All workers are trained' descreve a regra sem citar quem treina.

commonErrors.have: Aqui o sentido é passivo (são treinados), não present perfect. Use 'are trained'.

exercises.title: 3. Monte a frase de tendência
exercises.explanation: 'Our incident rate has decreased this year' mostra melhoria com present perfect. Tendência positiva conta a história.

exercises.title: 4. Combine o termo de SST com o significado
exercises.explanation: Esses quatro termos sustentam todo report de segurança. Saber o significado exato evita erro num QBR.

exercises.title: 5. Escreva seu mini-report de segurança (3 frases)
exercises.prompt: Escreva 3 frases de report de segurança para o Google: um resultado (present perfect), um processo padrão (voz passiva) e a tendência. Use ao menos 3 termos em inglês desta lição. A correção é só sobre o uso dos termos.
exercises.modelAnswer: We have recorded zero lost-time incidents this quarter. All workers are trained, and the site is reviewed every week. Our incident rate has decreased, and we comply with every safety standard.
exercises.explanation: Resultado, processo e tendência: as três frases que estruturam qualquer report de SST forte.

lessons.critical: Em voz alta, faça um mini-report de segurança ao Google: um resultado com 'We have...', um processo com 'are trained/reviewed' e a tendência. Sem texto na frente.
takeaways: I can report results with 'We have recorded zero incidents'.
I can describe a process with 'All workers are trained'.
I can say 'The site is reviewed every week'.
I can show a trend with 'Our rate has decreased'.
I can say we comply with every safety standard.

lessons.title: Apresentação 3 — QBR de segurança e relacionamento com o Google
lessons.objective: Ao final desta aula você conduz um QBR completo de segurança e relacionamento com o Google — abertura do trimestre, resultados de segurança e plano para o próximo trimestre.
lessons.overview:
Today is the job site of the final capstone: with the teacher in the role of Google, you lead a safety and relationship QBR (quarterly business review). There is no new theory, you bring everything together: presentation structure, safety numbers and partnership language. It is the closing of the course.

The tone here is different from the pitch and the negotiation. A QBR is a conversation between long-term partners. You look back (look back) and look ahead (look ahead): you celebrate the quarter (It's been a strong quarter), show the safety highlights and the compliance score, and present an action plan for the next quarter.

The business goal is to renew and deepen the partnership with Google, which demands global standards on every project. You show that the teams are certified, that Racional is committed to safety and you propose to lock in the dates for the next cycle. Closing the course by leading this conversation is the proof that you can already talk about operations and relationships, in English, with a big data client.
lessons.intro:
Sem teoria nova. Junte as três peças do QBR em frases-âncora.

Abertura: "It's been a strong quarter." · Resultado: "Our teams are certified and our compliance score is high." · Próximo passo: "For next quarter, let's lock in the dates."
lessons.situation: Reunião trimestral (QBR) com o Google: você abre o trimestre, apresenta os resultados de segurança da obra e propõe o plano e as datas do próximo ciclo.
lessons.context: Thank you, and welcome to our quarterly review. It's been a strong quarter for our partnership. Let me share the highlights. Our teams are certified, and our compliance score is high. We have maintained zero lost-time incidents on your site. We are committed to the same standard for next quarter. Here is our action plan, and I'd like to lock in the dates today. We are proud to be your long-term partner. Let's look back with pride and look ahead together.

vocab.example: Our partnership is strong.
It's been a strong quarter for safety.
We have maintained zero incidents.
Our teams are certified.
Our compliance score is high.
We are committed to safety.
Let's make a joint action plan.
Here is our plan for next quarter.
Let's lock in the dates today.
Our partnership is built on trust.
Let me share the highlights.
Here is our action plan.
We want to be your long-term partner.

vocab.pt: olhar para trás / olhar para frente

exercises.title: 1. Como abrir o QBR com o Google?
exercises.prompt: Você inicia a revisão trimestral com um parceiro de longo prazo. Qual abertura é a mais natural?

options.text: Welcome to our quarterly review. It's been a strong quarter for our partnership.
Welcome. Now we talk only about the new price, please.
options.whyWrong: Um QBR é sobre resultados e relacionamento, não sobre preço. Comece celebrando a parceria.

options.text: Strong quarter been it's a our partnership.
options.whyWrong: Ordem das palavras quebrada. A frase correta é 'It's been a strong quarter for our partnership'.

exercises.explanation: Abrir com 'It's been a strong quarter for our partnership' marca o tom de parceria e olha para trás com orgulho.

exercises.title: 2. Escreva o miolo do QBR (3 frases)
exercises.prompt: Escreva 3 frases para o QBR com o Google: um destaque de segurança, o compromisso e o plano com as datas. Use ao menos 3 termos em inglês desta lição. A correção é só sobre o uso dos termos.
keywords: action plan|for next quarter|lock in the dates|long-term partner
exercises.modelAnswer: Let me share the highlights. Our teams are certified, and we have maintained a high compliance score. We are committed to safety, and for next quarter I'd like to lock in the dates with you.
exercises.explanation: Destaque, compromisso e plano: o miolo de um QBR que renova a parceria. Cada frase carrega um termo-âncora.

exercises.title: 3. Feche o QBR em voz alta
exercises.prompt: Leia o fechamento do QBR com o Google, com tom de parceria, terminando olhando para frente.
exercises.targetText: We are proud to be your long-term partner. Let's look back with pride and look ahead together.
exercises.translation: Temos orgulho de ser seu parceiro de longo prazo. Vamos olhar para trás com orgulho e para frente juntos.
exercises.explanation: Um QBR fecha reforçando o relacionamento. 'Look back and look ahead together' marca continuidade e confiança.

lessons.critical: Em voz alta, conduza 20 segundos de QBR com o Google: abra o trimestre, dê um destaque de segurança e proponha as datas do próximo ciclo. Sem texto na frente.
takeaways: I can open a QBR with 'It's been a strong quarter'.
I can present highlights and our compliance score.
I can say our teams are certified and committed to safety.
I can propose an action plan and lock in the dates.
I can close as a proud long-term partner.
